paper_cards.title: PBench: A Physical AI Benchmark for World Models
paper_cards.data: 1,044 conditioning-image/prompt samples and 5,636 manually corrected QA pairs across AV, robotics, industry, physics, human and commonsense domains.
paper_cards.method: Generate model rollouts, score domain behavior through ontology-grounded binary QA judged by Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct, combine with eight VBench quality metrics.
paper_cards.task: Evaluate physical-domain correctness and visual quality of image-conditioned world models.
paper_cards.novelty: Pairs domain-specific physical QA with conventional video-quality metrics across six Physical AI domains.
paper_cards.evidence: Official page publishes data, code links, examples, metric definition and model breakdowns; Cosmos-Predict2-14B reports 77.4 overall and 84.9 domain score.
paper_cards.limitations: VLM-as-judge dependence and an overall average can hide domain-specific failure; primarily evaluates video rollouts, not closed-loop control.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Reusable physical ontology, per-domain diagnostics and video-quality/physical-correctness split for embodied world evaluation.

paper_cards.title: WonderWorld: Interactive 3D Scene Generation from a Single Image
paper_cards.data: Single input images plus user camera/content controls; evaluation scenes span nature, city and campus imagery.
paper_cards.method: Fast Layered Gaussian Surfels, single-view layer generation, guided depth diffusion and iterative text-guided outpainting.
paper_cards.task: Interactively grow connected renderable 3D scenes from one image under camera and content control.
paper_cards.novelty: Makes user-steered 3D scene expansion low-latency, reporting under ten seconds for each connected scene on one A6000.
paper_cards.evidence: CVF paper, official project gallery, code and interactive videos show connected world expansion and controllable viewpoints.

claim_checks.claim: Less than ten seconds per generated scene
claim_checks.notes: Reported in paper abstract and evaluation.

paper_cards.limitations: Scene is visually oriented rather than fully simulation-ready; depth seams, view-dependent artifacts and accumulated drift remain possible.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Direct baseline for incremental user-controlled world building and latency-aware interactive generation.

paper_cards.title: WonderPlay: Dynamic 3D Scene Generation from a Single Image and Actions
paper_cards.data: Single images and action controls over examples covering rigid, elastic, cloth, smoke, liquid and granular materials.
paper_cards.method: Reconstructs background and objects as Gaussian surfels, estimates material classes/parameters, runs material-specific physics solvers, conditions a video generator on coarse dynamics, then updates 3D state by differentiable rendering.
paper_cards.task: Generate action-conditioned dynamic 3D scenes with diverse physical materials.
paper_cards.novelty: Closes a loop between coarse multi-material physics and expressive video generation rather than restricting simulation to rigid/simple elastic motion.
paper_cards.evidence: ICCV paper and official project provide architecture, qualitative videos, comparisons and material/action examples.

claim_checks.notes: Project links code lineage; verify full training release before reproduction.

paper_cards.limitations: Material estimates and reconstructed geometry are approximate; video prior may improve appearance without guaranteeing physical correctness.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Strong executable-world reference for typed material state, force controls and hybrid neural/analytic simulation.

paper_cards.title: ABot-PhysWorld: Interactive World Foundation Model for Robotic Manipulation with Physics Alignment
paper_cards.data: Three million physics-annotated robot-manipulation clips; released SFT data and EZS-Bench zero-shot robot/task/scene combinations.
paper_cards.method: 14B diffusion transformer with physics-aware DPO, decoupled discriminators and parallel context blocks for spatial action injection.
paper_cards.task: Generate realistic, action-controllable manipulation futures and evaluate zero-shot physical/action alignment.
paper_cards.novelty: Separates physics and visual-quality preference signals while injecting cross-embodiment actions spatially.
paper_cards.evidence: Official paper and repository release inference, SFT/DPO training, data and EZS-Bench; repository reports first on WorldArena and second in CVPR 2026 GigaBrain track.
paper_cards.limitations: Leaderboard results are reported by authors; 14B scale raises reproduction cost; video plausibility remains an imperfect proxy for executable dynamics.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Open action-to-video world-model baseline with explicit physics alignment and reproducible zero-shot evaluation.

paper_cards.title: PAIWorld: A 3D-Consistent World Foundation Model for Robotic Manipulation
paper_cards.data: 2.5M clips mixed from Robocoin, RobotWin, RoboMind and Galaxea, with multi-view robot trajectories and challenge evaluations.
paper_cards.method: Flow-matching DiT augmented with Geometry-Aware Cross-View Attention, camera-ray/pose Geo-RoPE and Latent 3D-REPA feature-relation distillation.
paper_cards.task: Generate geometrically consistent multi-camera robot futures for prediction, planning and policy post-training.
paper_cards.novelty: Combines an explicit inter-view path and 3D geometric training prior to address object drift, depth contradiction and texture mismatch.
paper_cards.evidence: Official paper/project show multi-view rollouts, depth maps, benchmark tables and downstream planning/policy examples; reports first on WorldArena and second on AgiBot Challenge 2026.

claim_checks.notes: Official page links leaderboards; phrased as reported.

paper_cards.limitations: Geometric consistency does not guarantee contact or material physics; compute and release completeness should be checked before reproduction.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Direct multi-view world-action baseline and a source of geometry-consistency metrics for robot rollouts.

paper_cards.title: PAI-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark For Physical AI
paper_cards.data: 2,808 real-world cases across driving, robotics, smart-space and egocentric domains; separate public generation, conditional-generation and understanding datasets.
paper_cards.method: Task-aligned evaluation suite for video generation, spatially conditioned video generation and physical video understanding.
paper_cards.task: Measure perception and prediction capabilities of physical-AI models.
paper_cards.novelty: Unifies unconditional/conditioned generation and understanding under one cross-domain physical-AI suite.
paper_cards.evidence: Primary paper and official MIT-licensed repository provide datasets, leaderboard and CVPR 2026 Oral status.
paper_cards.limitations: Aggregate suite breadth may dilute robotics-specific diagnosis; some metrics inherit weaknesses of automated video evaluation.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Useful umbrella evaluation protocol spanning generated futures, control-conditioned futures and physical understanding.

paper_cards.title: PhysBench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Vision-Language Models for Physical World Understanding
paper_cards.data: 10,002 interleaved video-image-text entries across 19 subclasses and physical properties, relationships, scenes and dynamics.
paper_cards.method: Multi-choice multimodal benchmark plus PhysAgent, which couples a general VLM with specialist perception tools.
paper_cards.task: Evaluate and improve VLM physical-world perception and reasoning.
paper_cards.novelty: Large, broad physical-understanding benchmark with evaluation over 75 VLMs and transfer studies.
paper_cards.evidence: ICLR paper, official project, dataset and evaluation code document scale, categories and baseline results.
paper_cards.limitations: Question answering is upstream of embodied action; multiple-choice success may not translate to intervention quality.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Physical-property and dynamics diagnostics can serve as perception/reasoning prerequisites for executable worlds.
